STATISTICAL ANALYSIS
  Independent fresh runs, no shared seed -> unpaired design, n=10/cell; mean, median, SD, descriptive 95% t-CI (df=9).
  No significance tests, no ranking.

LIMITATIONS
  - Chunk-size performance tradeoff not modelled; chunk actions may be uninformative.
  - Credit assignment approximate under concurrency>1.
  - n=10; no seeds; loss/combined high wall-clock variance.
  - Horizon varies by scenario (baseline/throttle 122 learned; latency/combined 32; loss 64 or 122).
  - No post-warm-up policy evolution was observed; no superiority claim.
  - Fairness not implemented; no aria2/IDM comparison.
